breakdown.description: The setup describes a vertical bubble column with gas injected to rise along the Y-axis, but gravity is applied horizontally, which would push the bubbles sideways instead of upwards.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that gravity should act vertically downwards in a vertical bubble column. It changed the gravity vector to `g (0 -9.81 0)`, which aligns with the specified vertical Y-axis, ensuring the buoyant force will correctly drive the bubbles upwards.
